cues.text: Did you know that a smaller court can make the game of football feel bigger?
cues.title: SMALLER COURT. BIGGER GAME.

cues.text: That’s the secret of futsal.
cues.title: THAT’S FUTSAL

cues.text: The space is tighter, the ball arrives faster, and every player is closer to the action.
cues.title: TIGHTER. FASTER. CLOSER.

cues.text: There’s less time to wait.
cues.title: LESS TIME TO WAIT

cues.text: Less room to hide.
cues.title: LESS ROOM TO HIDE

cues.text: And more opportunities to make a decision.
cues.title: MORE DECISIONS

cues.text: On a full-sized pitch, a young player might have several seconds to control the ball and look around.
cues.title: ON A FULL PITCH

cues.text: In futsal, those seconds become moments.
cues.title: SECONDS BECOME MOMENTS

cues.text: You learn to scan before the ball arrives,
cues.title: SCAN EARLY

cues.text: control it in tight spaces,
cues.title: CONTROL IN TIGHT SPACES

cues.text: combine quickly with teammates,
cues.title: COMBINE QUICKLY

cues.text: and create solutions when every path seems closed.
cues.title: FIND SOLUTIONS

cues.text: And because there are fewer players, everyone becomes part of the game.
cues.title: EVERYONE IS IN IT

cues.text: You attack.
cues.title: ATTACK

cues.text: You defend.
cues.title: DEFEND

cues.text: You move.
cues.title: MOVE

cues.text: You think.
cues.title: THINK

cues.text: People often see futsal as a smaller version of football.
cues.title: A SMALLER GAME?

cues.text: But it doesn’t make the game smaller.
cues.title: BIGGER POSSIBILITIES

cues.text: It makes every touch, movement, and decision more important.
cues.title: EVERY TOUCH MATTERS

cues.text: The court may be small, but the lessons travel everywhere.
cues.title: LESSONS TRAVEL EVERYWHERE

cues.text: Because when players learn to solve problems in tight spaces, the full-sized pitch begins to feel wide open.
cues.title: WIDE OPEN
